goldens.input: I forgot my master password, what can I do?
goldens.reference_answer: The master password cannot be reset; use your recovery key to regain access.

goldens.input: How many users does the Family plan include and what does it cost?
goldens.reference_answer: The Family plan costs $5 per month and covers up to 6 users.

goldens.input: Is there a Safari browser extension?
goldens.reference_answer: The Product Four documentation does not cover browser extensions, so it cannot be confirmed.
